names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 11453, «Геннадий (Здоровцев), иерей, сщмч.», with the two rank words after the comma left off. The day line gives the name without the surname — «Сщмч. Геннадия пресвитера (1918).» — so the surname is read from the name link and is part of the form. `fk.mjs` returns no holder for «геннадии здоровцев»; the bare «Геннадий» was not stored, the corpus keeping eleven folders of that name.

death.note: The year the day line prints for him: «Сщмч. Геннадия пресвитера (1918).» Neither page gives a year of birth and none was inferred.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Геннадия пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry. THE CALENDAR GIVES NO LIFE: the line links to his name and to no reading, and name page 11453 prints the title and «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 5 июля» and nothing else. `new-martyr` rests on that first day, the general commemoration of the new martyrs of Russia, which was NOT read. `office` is the name page’s «иерей», priest, which the four locale packs carry, against the day line’s «пресвитера». The eleven `gennadius-` folders in the corpus were listed before this one was made and none is a twentieth-century Russian priest. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
